readerCopy.body: A fuller version of identity can become easier to show without preparing a defense before anything has actually been challenged. When the Sun trines Lilith, identity and autonomy reinforce each other, making an inconvenient, unconventional, less polished, or less approved part easier to include in public view. The point is not becoming shocking. The ease reveals how much energy had been going into apologizing for something that did not need to be treated as a problem first.
